subject.title: [Bug]: Regression of #65533 — reasoning/reasoning_details completely dropped from message history for MiniMax M3 via OpenRouter (both plain-text and tool-call turns)

question: Should maintainers accept the linked PR's route-accurate loopback/provider proof as sufficient for the MiniMax M3 OpenRouter/custom-provider replay fix, or require live OpenRouter/MiniMax M3 next-request payload proof before landing?
rationale: The issue is valid from source inspection and has an open fix PR, but live hosted MiniMax/OpenRouter proof is not present and the PR is currently conflicting.

options.title: Accept Route-Accurate Proof After Refresh
options.body: Refresh or resolve the conflicting linked PR and accept the production transport loopback/provider payload proof as sufficient if the merge result still covers both plain-text and tool-call replay.

options.title: Require Live OpenRouter Proof
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until a maintainer or contributor supplies redacted live OpenRouter/MiniMax M3 next-request payload evidence for both turn shapes.

options.title: Request A Narrow Replacement
options.body: If the PR cannot be refreshed safely, keep this issue as canonical and request a replacement fix with equivalent tests and proof.

recommendation.title: Accept Route-Accurate Proof After Refresh
recommendation.body: Refresh or resolve the conflicting linked PR and accept the production transport loopback/provider payload proof as sufficient if the merge result still covers both plain-text and tool-call replay.

likelyOwner.reason: This person already reviewed the linked PR's proof/fix direction and identified the custom-provider path as the relevant remaining question.
